map.是。Verhoeff 是十进制非线性校验，能检出全部单位数字错误与全部相邻换位错: Yes. Verhoeff is a decimal nonlinear checksum that detects all single-digit errors and all adjacent transpositions, with higher error-detection capability than Luhn (whose transposition detection is about 90%); but both only verify number structure, not true existence.
map.Aadhaar 号码有什么格式要求？: What are the format requirements for an Aadhaar number?
map.12 位纯数字，首位通常为 2–9（不以 0/1 开头）；输入可含空格或连字符，: 12 pure digits, first digit usually 2-9 (not starting with 0/1); input may contain spaces or hyphens, the page normalizes before validating.
map.校验通过能当身份证明吗？: Can a passed validation serve as identity proof?
map.不能。校验只说明号码结构与校验位自洽，是否为真实、有效的 Aadhaar 号须通: No. Validation only means the number structure and check digit are self-consistent; whether it is a real, valid Aadhaar number must be verified through official channels.
